name: Two Angels
note: A quiet embrace disguised as a single winged figure. Two beings complete one another, their shared wings making flight possible.

name: Protection
note: In warm ochre and gold, two figures merge. A winged presence holds another close, giving shape to the felt experience of protection.

name: Thought
note: A woman appears beneath the coils of a dragon, her thoughts made almost tangible against a surface that resembles an ancient wall.

name: Blossom
note: A human profile dissolves into branches and leaves. Painted without preliminary design, the work holds the moment when a form emerges from the act of painting.

name: Winter Blooming
note: A face emerges through lilac and blue foliage, caught between winter and flowering. The image grows out of an intuitive painting process.

name: The Id, Ego, and Superego
note: Three faces overlap within a single orange field, bringing division and integration into the same gesture.

name: The Touch
note: Two faces draw close. In a restricted palette of fire and ochre, the painting leaves only the encounter: closeness, contact, union.

name: Intimacy
note: Two figures meet at close range. A raised hand becomes at once a gesture of touch and a possible boundary.

name: Ardhanarishvara
note: Drawing on the joined form of Shiva and Shakti, this winged figure changes character between shadow and light.

name: Dancing Angel
note: An embrace becomes a movement forward, a dance through uncertainty.

name: Dancing Valkyrie
note: A winged figure strides through darkness, connecting mythological traditions through a swift painterly gesture.

name: Buddha
note: A meditating figure merges with vertical streams of colour, suggesting stillness within transformation.

name: She
note: An icon-like gaze interrupted by disquiet; stillness and rupture are held in the same image.

name: Meditation (Fire)
note: Part of a monumental triptych in which a seated figure dissolves into the element of fire.

name: Meditation (Flower)
note: The body becomes entangled with growth and foliage in the second panel of the Meditation triptych.

name: Meditation (Water)
note: The final panel submerges the meditating body in a field of cerulean and ice blue.
